title: Catalyst Proposal
description: A single proposal submitted to Project Catalyst, normalized across all funds (F1-F15) and all source systems (Lidonation, IOG voting-results, Catalyst Voices, IdeaScale/Wayback).

proposal_id.description: Canonical identifier minted by this archive. Format: 'f{fund:02d}-{slug}' where slug is the URL-safe proposal slug from the primary source. Stable across refreshes.

external_ids.description: IDs from upstream source systems for cross-reference.

fund.description: Fund number (1-15 at time of writing).

challenge.description: Challenge / category / campaign within the fund (e.g., 'Open Source Development', 'F10 Cardano DApps Mass Adoption').

proposer_ids.description: Canonical proposer IDs from proposer.schema.json. Multiple entries when the proposal had a team.

amount_requested.description: Requested funding amount in the proposal's currency (typically ADA, but USD or USDM in later funds).

amount_received.description: Amount actually awarded. 0 for not-funded; null when unknown.

yes_votes.description: Yes votes (raw lovelace for older funds, normalized count for newer). Units documented in sources entry.

funding_status.description: Did this proposal pass the vote and receive funding? 'approved' = funded; 'not_approved' = lost vote; 'over_budget' = passed vote but ran out of budget; 'leftover' = funded from leftover budget; 'withdrawn' = pulled before vote.

project_status.description: Delivery state for funded proposals. 'unfunded' for proposals that did not pass.

funded_at.description: Timestamp when funding was confirmed/disbursed (where known).

completed_at.description: Timestamp when final milestone / closeout was accepted (F10+ via Milestone Module).

links.description: Canonical URLs for this proposal on each source system.

summary.description: Short proposer-authored summary / pitch / excerpt. May be markdown.

ai_summary.description: AI-generated summary. When present, must be attributed in sources (typically Lidonation).

milestone_count.description: Number of milestones in the SoM (Statement of Milestones). Null when not applicable / unknown.

sources.description: Provenance for every field in this record. At minimum, the source that established the proposal's existence.

provenance_path.description: Relative path within this repo to the raw captured artifact, e.g. '_provenance/lidonation/page-127.json.gz'.

fields_provided.description: Which proposal fields this source contributed to (for field-level provenance auditing).

confidence.description: Aggregate record confidence. See docs/DATA_QUALITY.md for criteria.

field_confidence.description: Optional per-field confidence overrides for fields whose confidence differs from the aggregate. Keys are field names from this schema; values are confidence levels.

notes.description: Free-form curator notes. Used for edge cases (cancellations, disputes, reconciliation comments).
